visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with a montage collage showcasing Ghibli Park highlights, including Yubaba's desk and Howl's Moving Castle. (2) A woman in a white blouse and olive skirt walks through a brick archway into the park. (3) Shots of the clock tower bridge with tourists under a clear blue sky. (4) Various bronze Ghibli character statues are shown outdoors against green foliage and stone walls. (5) Detailed close-ups of architectural features like Howl's Moving Castle and European-style facades. (6) Inside 'Ghibli's Grand Warehouse,' vibrant mosaic stairs lead to a blue building under a large hangar-like roof. (7) An extreme close-up of Yubaba's office exhibit shows her writing amidst flying papers and three green heads. (8) A large mossy robot statue stands against a rock wall. (9) Food scenes follow, showing hands cutting into a savory pie and plates of fried chicken wings (tebasaki) on a restaurant table. (10) The camera captures hotel exteriors and a triple-bed room interior, finishing with city shopping signs.

(4) [Subtitle]: 園區內可以拍的場景超級多 吉卜力大粉絲來一定超興奮. (5) [Subtitle]: 大部分都是戶外空間 晴天來最完美!. (6) [Subtitle]: 親眼看到這些建築 真的覺得超級震撼. [Variety]: 可愛!. (7) [Subtitle]: 吉卜力大倉庫 這區我覺得最好拍!. (8) [Subtitle]: 而且它幾乎都是室內 夏天來避暑、冬天來遊玩. (9) [Subtitle]: 超擬真的場景 一秒把你帶回動畫裡. (10) [Subtitle]: 來之前記得先把手機容量清一下 不然很容易拍到爆記憶體. (11) [Subtitle]: 逛餓了裡面也有餐廳可以用餐. (12) [Subtitle]: 餐點中規中矩 候位的人不少唷. (13) [Subtitle]: 吉卜力公園 各國區門票要分開買. (14) [Subtitle]: 建議先上官網調查 看看你喜歡的動畫在哪一區. (15) [Subtitle]: 我這次去了大倉庫 + 魔女之谷 大概花了半天以上的時間. (16) [Subtitle]: 整體來說超好拍的!. (17) [Logo]: WASHINGTON HOTEL PLAZA Nagoya Sakae. [Subtitle]: 接著去飯店辦理入住手續. (18) [Subtitle]: 我們訂了三人房 空間偏小但夠用!. (19) [Subtitle]: 交通也蠻方便的. (20) [Logo]: Alpen NAGOYA. [Subtitle]: 放完行李後 直衝 Alpen NAGOYA 購物. (21) [Subtitle]: 東西超多! 好好買!. (22) [Logo]: 風來坊. [Subtitle]: 晚餐吃我心心念念的手羽先. (23) [Subtitle]: 這間肉很嫩 還撒上大量胡椒粉提味. (24) [Subtitle]: 真的超好吃 推薦你們一定要試試!.
